standard.summary: 在标准 loss 基础上额外计算小波变换（DWT）频率域的 loss，让模型更关注高频细节（发丝、纹理、边缘）。
standard.effect: wavelet_loss_levels=2 做 2 级 DWT 分解，high_freq_weight=2.0 让高频子带（LH/HL/HH）的 loss 权重翻倍。约增加 15% 计算开销。
standard.whenToUse: 追求细节质量（纹理、毛发、文字）时。标准 loss 训练后细节不够锐利时。
standard.avoidWhen: 训练初期（先用标准 loss 确认基本训练正常）。低分辨率训练（<512px 时高频信息本就很少）。

standard_en.summary: Computes an additional loss in the wavelet-transform (DWT) frequency domain on top of the standard loss, which makes the model attend more to high-frequency detail (hair strands, texture, edges).
standard_en.effect: wavelet_loss_levels=2 performs a 2-level DWT decomposition, and high_freq_weight=2.0 doubles the loss weight on the high-frequency subbands (LH/HL/HH). It adds about 15% computational overhead.
standard_en.whenToUse: When chasing detail quality (texture, fur, text). When detail is not sharp enough after training with the standard loss.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Early in training (confirm basic training is healthy with the standard loss first). Low-resolution training (below 512px there is little high-frequency information to begin with).

advanced.principle: 对 pred 和 target 做 2D DWT（Haar 小波），得到 LL（低频近似）、LH（水平细节）、HL（垂直细节）、HH（对角细节）四个子带。分别计算每个子带的 loss，加权求和。wavelet_loss_base_loss 控制子带内用的 loss 函数（l2 或 l1）。
advanced.intervention: training_step 中 loss 计算后叠加 wavelet loss。
advanced.expectedImpact: 高频细节改善明显（发丝、织物纹理）。可能略微降低整体构图稳定性。
advanced.tradeoffs: 与 min_snr_gamma 组合效果更好。wavelet_loss_approx_weight 控制 LL 子带权重（通常设 0 因为标准 loss 已覆盖）。

advanced_en.principle: A 2D DWT (Haar wavelet) of pred and target yields four subbands: LL (low-frequency approximation), LH (horizontal detail), HL (vertical detail), HH (diagonal detail). Each subband's loss is computed separately and summed with weights. wavelet_loss_base_loss controls the per-subband loss function (l2 or l1).
advanced_en.intervention: In training_step, the wavelet loss is stacked after the loss computation.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Noticeable high-frequency detail improvement (hair strands, fabric textures). May slightly reduce overall composition stability.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Combines well with min_snr_gamma. wavelet_loss_approx_weight controls the LL subband weight (usually 0 because the standard loss already covers it).
